title: An EmDash form's words change through the form door and the form stays a form; a contact detail in the research's own words is collected; what follows a record's own words is not its structure
steps: S1: tracy_emdash form_words on a quote form: new labels, placeholders, option labels, page title and submit label; then calls naming a field name, required, an empty label, a recipient, an unknown field, another count of options.
S2: checkCollectedUsed with the research's page text holding the street, a second street and the email, the profile's fields empty; then a street and an email the research never read.
S3: compareAgentInventory on an EmDash post whose reading time, table of contents and lede follow its rewritten text, and a status a visitor reads; then a machine status changed.
expect: S1: forms/update carries the form with only those words changed (option values, names, recipients kept); every other call is refused BAD_CALL and nothing is written (a recipient key is dropped, never sent).
S2: no COLLECTED_UNSOURCED for the research's details; the two others are COLLECTED_UNSOURCED.
S3: passes; the machine status fails.

tests: form_words sends the form back with only its words changed
form_words refuses what is not a word, an unknown field and another count of options, writing nothing
collected-used: a contact detail in the research’s own words is collected; one it never read still fails
EmDash: a reading time and a table of contents that follow the text, a lede written where there was none and a status a visitor reads keep the structure; a machine status does not
